definition.name: Business Expenses
definition.comment: Incurred expenses, no payment status. SQL recalculates allocations from historical contributions; referral transaction identity is immutable. No historical backfill.

Payee Name.name: Payee Name
Payee Name.comment: R140: who is paid: a typed name, or the payee borrower's name when the expense was saved (a snapshot; reads show the live borrower name through "Ref Payee Borrower").

Ref Payee Borrower.name: Ref Payee Borrower
Ref Payee Borrower.comment: R140: the borrower who is paid: the referrer of a referral rebate, or the borrower chosen as payee of a manual expense (null when the payee is a typed name).

Ref Paid By Cash Holder.name: Ref Paid By Cash Holder
Ref Paid By Cash Holder.comment: R140: the holder of "Ref Paid By Cash Account" (derived from it). Null together with the account on a Manual expense above zero that is no R005 cutover source means pending payment.

Ref Paid By Cash Account.name: Ref Paid By Cash Account
Ref Paid By Cash Account.comment: R140: the cash account that paid the expense. Null on a Manual expense above zero that is no R005 cutover source means pending payment: no cash movement until an account is set (the movement is then dated on the Expense Date).

Ref Offset Payment.name: Ref Offset Payment
Ref Offset Payment.comment: R111: the Referral Rebate Offset payment that settled this referral rebate on the referrer's loan; null when the rebate is paid out. Set by Loan Close only.

Rebate Rate.name: Rebate Rate
Rebate Rate.comment: R120: referral rebate rate (percent) applied when this rebate was booked (REFERRAL_REBATE_V2); null on rows booked before V135 and on other expenses.

Rebate Cap.name: Rebate Cap
Rebate Cap.comment: R120: referral rebate cap (baht) applied when this rebate was booked (REFERRAL_REBATE_V2); null on rows booked before V135 and on other expenses.

Ref Rebate Settlement.name: Ref Rebate Settlement
Ref Rebate Settlement.comment: R129/R184: the most recently recorded settlement that applied an amount to this referral rebate (REFERRAL_REBATE_V3); null exactly when no settlement did (pending in full, offset-only and legacy rows, other expenses). Set, moved and cleared by the settlement command only.

Paid Date.name: Paid Date
Paid Date.comment: R140: the day a manual expense was paid (its cash movement date). Null means the cash moved on the Expense Date. Set only on a Manual expense with a paying account that is no R005 cutover source; null while pending and on referral rebates.

definition.name: pwa_rebate_settlement_allocations
definition.comment: R184: the amount one rebate settlement applied to one referral rebate expense (REFERRAL_REBATE_V3). A rebate's pending amount is its Amount less its close-time offset less the sum of its rows here. Inserted and deleted only by pwa_apply_rebate_settlement_v1; never updated.

expense_id.name: expense_id
expense_id.comment: R184: the referral rebate expense it paid toward.

amount.name: amount
amount.comment: R184: whole baht applied, above zero, at most what was pending when the settlement was recorded.

pwa_rebate_settlement_allocations_amount.name: pwa_rebate_settlement_allocations_amount_check
pwa_rebate_settlement_allocations_amount.definition: CHECK (amount > 0::numeric AND amount < 'Infinity'::numeric AND amount = trunc(amount))

definition.name: pwa_rebate_settlements
definition.comment: R129/R184: one referral rebate settlement of one referrer: the amounts in pwa_rebate_settlement_allocations, paid by Lisa in one cash movement on settlement_date, or offset to the referrer's own loan (offset_payment_id). Written only by pwa_apply_rebate_settlement_v1; immutable (delete and record again).

id.name: id
id.comment: R129: the rebate-settlement.create command's targetId (client UUID v4).

settlement_date.name: settlement_date
settlement_date.comment: R129/R184: the cash movement date; not in the future (Bangkok business date), not before the newest close date of the rebates it pays; today for an offset.

amount.name: amount
amount.comment: R129/R184: whole baht, the sum of its rows in pwa_rebate_settlement_allocations.

paid_by_cash_account.name: paid_by_cash_account
paid_by_cash_account.comment: R129/R184: an active account of ch:lisa, checked by the apply function; Lisa's default account for an offset (its receipt returns to the same account).

offset_payment_id.name: offset_payment_id
offset_payment_id.comment: R184: null when the settlement was paid to the referrer; else the Referral Rebate Offset payment (rs155:<id>) it posted on the referrer's own loan.

pwa_rebate_settlements_amount_check.name: pwa_rebate_settlements_amount_check
pwa_rebate_settlements_amount_check.definition: CHECK (amount > 0::numeric AND amount < 'Infinity'::numeric AND amount = trunc(amount))

pwa_rebate_settlements_check.name: pwa_rebate_settlements_check
pwa_rebate_settlements_check.definition: CHECK (bank_reference IS NULL OR octet_length(bank_reference) >= 1 AND octet_length(bank_reference) <= 256 AND btrim(bank_reference) <> ''::text AND bank_reference !~ '[\r\n]'::text AND payment_method = 'Bank Transfer'::text)

pwa_rebate_settlements_payment_method_ch.name: pwa_rebate_settlements_payment_method_check
pwa_rebate_settlements_payment_method_ch.definition: CHECK (offset_payment_id IS NULL AND (payment_method = ANY (ARRAY['Bank Transfer'::text, 'Cash'::text])) OR offset_payment_id IS NOT NULL AND payment_method = 'Referral Rebate Offset'::text)

definition.name: pwa_rebate_pending_v1
definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pwa_rebate_pending_v1(p_expense text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN x."Rule Version"='REFERRAL_REBATE_V3'
   THEN greatest(x."Amount"::numeric-coalesce(o."Amount Received"::numeric,0)
    -coalesce((SELECT sum(a.amount) FROM public.pwa_rebate_settlement_allocations a WHERE a.expense_id=x."Row ID"),0),0) ELSE 0 END -- R184
 FROM public."Business Expenses" x LEFT JOIN public."Payments" o ON o."Row ID"=x."Ref Offset Payment"
 WHERE x."Row ID"=p_expense AND x."Source Type"='Referral Rebate';
$function$
definition.comment: R129/R184: the pending (unpaid) amount of a referral rebate expense: REFERRAL_REBATE_V3, Amount less its close-time offset payment less the amounts settlements applied to it (pwa_rebate_settlement_allocations); 0 for offset-only, paid and legacy rows; null for an unknown or non-referral expense. Read only.

definition.name: pwa_rebates_owed_v1
definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pwa_rebates_owed_v1(p_referrer text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(sum(greatest(x."Amount"::numeric-coalesce(o."Amount Received"::numeric,0)
   -coalesce((SELECT sum(a.amount) FROM public.pwa_rebate_settlement_allocations a WHERE a.expense_id=x."Row ID"),0),0)),0) -- R184
 FROM public."Business Expenses" x LEFT JOIN public."Payments" o ON o."Row ID"=x."Ref Offset Payment"
 WHERE x."Ref Payee Borrower"=p_referrer AND x."Source Type"='Referral Rebate' AND x."Rule Version"='REFERRAL_REBATE_V3';
$function$
definition.comment: R129: what a referrer is owed: the sum of pwa_rebate_pending_v1 over the referrer's referral rebate expenses. Read only.
